# INA — Intent Assistant

> INA is a proactive AI agent for digital health, digital well-being, and intentional digital living. It helps people keep their computer activity aligned with their stated intentions through context-aware assessment, clarification, and lightweight interventions.

## Paper

- Title: State Your Intention to Steer Your Attention: An AI Assistant for Intentional Digital Living
- Venue: Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI 2026)
- Authors: Juheon Choi; Juyong Lee; Jian Kim; ChanYoung Kim; Taywon Min; W. Bradley Knox; Min Kyung Lee; Kimin Lee
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1145/3772318.3791404
- arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.14513
- Full text PDF: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.14513

## Research Summary

INA elicits a user's intention and assesses whether ongoing computer activity aligns with it. The system reasons over screen context, application titles, and URLs, asks clarifying questions when needed, and provides context-aware nudges when attention drifts. It is positioned at the intersection of proactive AI agents, digital health, digital well-being, attention management, and human-computer interaction.

The system was evaluated in a three-week within-subjects field study with 22 participants and compared with passive activity logging and fixed rule-based reminders. The project website reports improvements in focus and intention alignment and a reduction in off-task activity.
